name: Cut After Noon
summary: The woodcutters of Barovia cut what they need by noon and go home. Grigore's son stayed late, and brought something back.

stages.journal: Vasile and Petre say Grigore the woodcutter's lad, Luca, went out for the last load two days ago, came home after dark, said nothing and went to bed. He hasn't got up since.
objectives: Ask Grigore about his son; he hauls wood on the west road by day
stages.hint: Find Grigore the woodcutter hauling wood by his yard on the village's west road, and ask about Luca.

stages.journal: Luca stayed in the woods by the west road to cut a bit more after noon, which his father has told him a hundred times not to do. He came home late with a load of pale wood and has slept ever since. Grigore sold the load to Bildrath for the price of the medicine he couldn't afford.
objectives: Look at the wood Luca cut: Grigore's woodpile on the west road, or Bildrath's back room
stages.hint: Look at the pale logs on Grigore's woodpile on the west road, or the load Luca sold to Bildrath's back room.

stages.journal: The late wood isn't firewood. The sap runs red and the grain runs the wrong way: it is seedwood, the kind that grows up into blights. Luca has a splinter of it in his palm, working its way in. The wood wants him.
objectives: Burn every stick of the late wood by day, Bildrath's load too
Or wait in Grigore's yard for whatever comes at dusk
stages.hint: Burn all the late wood by day, Grigore's pile and Bildrath's load, or wait in Grigore's yard at dusk.

stages.journal: We burned the late wood in Grigore's yard. It screamed in the fire, and what crawled out of the ashes we finished with steel.
objectives: Get the splinter out of Luca's hand
stages.hint: Talk to Grigore and get the splinter out of Luca's hand (Medicine helps).

stages.journal: At dusk the late wood walked. Bildrath's load rolled up the street on its own, and Grigore's woodpile stood up as one thing and reached for the boy. We cut it down in the yard.
objectives: Get the splinter out of Luca's hand
stages.hint: Talk to Grigore and get the splinter out of Luca's hand (Medicine helps).

stages.journal: Luca is awake. The late trees by the west road grew where a man in a bear's hide planted seeds in the spring, singing to them. He told Luca the hill wants the valley back. The hill must be Yester Hill, west of the Wizard of Wines.
